title: A Markov State Model of Solvent Features Reveals Water Dynamics in Protein-Peptide Binding
one_liner_zh: 该文用溶剂特征的马尔可夫状态模型研究p53肽-MDM2蛋白结合中的水动态，属广义蛋白-肽互作且方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系，但非TF-DNA核心对象。
abstract: In this work, we investigate the role of solvent in the binding reaction of p53 transactivation domain (TAD) peptide to its receptor MDM2. Previously, our group generated 831 μs of explicit-solvent aggregate molecular simulation trajectory data for the MDM2-p53 peptide binding reaction using large-scale distributed computing, and subsequently built a Markov State Model (MSM) of the binding reaction (Zhou et al. 2017). Here, we perform tICA anlaysis and construct an MSM using only solvent-based structural features, and find a remarkably similar landscape and implied timescales for the slowest motions. The solvent shells contributing most to the first tICA eigenvector are those centered on Lys24 and Thr18 of p53 TAD peptide in the range of 3–6 Å. Important solvent shells were visualized to reveal wetting and dewetting transitions along peptide-protein binding trajectories. Our results provide a solvent-centric view of the hydrophobic effect in action for a realistic peptide-protein binding scenario.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们探讨了溶剂在p53转录激活域（TAD）肽与其受体MDM2结合反应中的作用。此前，我们团队利用大规模分布式计算，为MDM2-p53肽结合反应生成了831微秒的显式溶剂聚合分子模拟轨迹数据，并随后构建了该结合反应的马尔可夫状态模型（Markov State Model, MSM）（Zhou等人，2017）。在此，我们仅基于溶剂结构特征进行tICA分析并构建MSM，发现最慢运动的景观和隐含时间尺度 remarkably 相似。对第一tICA特征向量贡献最大的溶剂壳层是那些以p53 TAD肽的Lys24和Thr18为中心、范围在3–6 Å内的壳层。通过可视化重要溶剂壳层，揭示了沿肽-蛋白质结合轨迹的润湿与去润湿转变。我们的结果为真实肽-蛋白质结合场景中疏水效应的作用提供了以溶剂为中心的视角。
